content: Negative PMI: We observe that using only $\mathit {\texttt {-}PMI}$ (rows $\mathit {\texttt {-}CPMI_{\texttt {-}2}}$ and $\mathit {\texttt {-}NNEGPMI}$) performs similarly to all other models in POS tagging and both syntactic probing tasks, but very poorly on all semantic tasks, strongly supporting our main claim that $\mathit {\texttt {-}PMI}$ mostly encodes syntactic information.
